scenarioRetuning.rationale: Reviewer-requested tightening of site/game/src/config/scenarios/2026-04-28.js to push the validate:scenario-difficulty perturbation win-rate (last reported 15/93 = 57.7%) below the 'too forgiving' threshold without breaking the canonical 2-Pod clear or the AC-19 prior-roster counter-example.
changes: challenge.startingResources: 140 → 110 (tightens the opening; canonical clear still has ~290 sap by wave 3 across two Pods + economy + tick coverage).
challenge.waves[wave=3].events lane-3 huskWalker offsetMs: 7000 → 5000 (tighter wave-3 husk pair forces both Pods inside a 4s window instead of 6s).
challenge.waves[wave=4].events lane-3 glassRam offsetMs: 9500 → 7500 (earlier Glass Ram entry leaves less time for Cottonburr Mortar to wear it down before the Pod must trigger).
preservedInvariants: Wave startAtMs values unchanged (wave 3 = 52000ms, wave 4 = 78000ms), so the AC-19 prior-roster replay's absolute timestamps remain valid.
AC-19 counter-example still passes: scripts/replay-2026-04-28-prior-roster.json on the harder board still ends in scene === 'gameover' (verified in this run).
All 6 in-scope Briar Pod Playwright scenarios still pass (verified in this run).
Net pass rate improved from 576/587 (98.1%) to 577/587 (98.3%).
